Mixed payers in practice (labs, philanthropy, governments); labs select and scope; embedded access pledged Sept 2026, not yet in force; nobody oversees evaluators.

Payer, access, publication

Who pays. Mixed: philanthropy, lab fees, government budgets. No accreditation.
Access. Voluntary pre-release API access, occasionally deeper; embedded access pledged September 2026.
Publication. System-card citations; some independent reports; redaction negotiated per engagement.
